title: TCD-016-C1 Explicit Rewetting Receiver, Activation and Kinetics Qualification
central_scientific_question: Can one concrete receiver, activation rule and transfer kinetics be scientifically qualified for M_surface_NH4_non_aqueous_continuation when rewetting occurs?

R0.name: instantaneous_complete_dissolution_to_surface_aqueous_NH4_at_first_representable_surface_water
basis: The continuation owner is deliberately chemically noncommittal, so complete water solubility cannot be inferred.
SQ03 explicitly left instantaneous dissolution and any activation threshold unqualified.
A representable numerical water volume is not by itself a physical dissolution trigger or timescale.
No qualified surface aqueous receiver mapping proves that all continuation mass enters that owner before runoff or infiltration.
missing: mixing timescale or justification for instantaneous transfer
ordering relative to runoff and infiltration

R1.name: partial_or_equilibrium_dissolution_to_surface_aqueous_NH4
basis: An equilibrium or kinetic dissolution law requires compound identity, counter-ion or material form, available interfacial area and water chemistry that the continuation owner does not define.
No parameter set with ANIMO provenance exists for this continuation state.
Introducing an empirical fraction would be parameter invention rather than qualification.
missing: surface area or morphology where required

R2.name: direct_transfer_to_layer1_aqueous_or_sorbed_NH4_during_infiltration
basis: SQ04 established that aqueous transport may act only after a qualified transfer to an aqueous owner and that soil NH4 sorption is a layer1-plus owner, not a continuation owner.
Using infiltration to remove continuation mass would silently couple water flux to an unqualified release fraction.
Direct sorbed routing would bypass an unqualified surface-to-soil phase transition.

R3.name: adapted_Conhtop_virtual_top_reservoir_as_rewetting_receiver
basis: SQ04 found Conhtop to be an upper-boundary input reservoir with different provenance and release semantics.
Adapting Conhtop would require a new owner contract, water-volume definition and release semantics rather than unchanged reuse.
No evidence establishes that a virtual additions reservoir is the physical receiver for residual continuation mass.
missing: scientific rather than numerical activation basis

R4.name: other_bounded_rewetting_law
basis: No additional receiver, activation rule and kinetic law is specified by the frozen ANIMO evidence.
A literature mechanism cannot be mapped to a chemically noncommittal continuation owner without first adding physical identity not qualified here.

R5.name: no_currently_qualifiable_rewetting_receiver_activation_kinetics_contract
R5.basis: Every positive candidate requires at least one unqualified physical-phase, receiver, activation, kinetics or parameter assumption. Conservation bounds and numerical water availability are insufficient to select the physics.

external_literature_reason: The first unresolved question is the physical and chemical identity of the continuation owner. External dissolution, sorption or remobilization laws are not transferable until that mapping exists; importing them now would create model semantics rather than support an already-defined process.
unlock_criteria: A separate scientific qualification of the physical or chemical identity of the continuation material sufficient to constrain solubility or remobilization behaviour.
A named receiver owner with explicit water or solid-phase state and compatible units.
A physical activation criterion distinguishable from a numerical concentration denominator guard.
A rate, equilibrium or transfer law with parameter provenance and an application envelope.
Observations or high-quality new-model-evolution evidence capable of falsifying complete, partial and direct-to-soil transfer alternatives.
Explicit ordering relative to ponding creation, runoff, infiltration, adsorption and transformations.
scientific_nonclaims: Rewetting does not imply complete dissolution by qualification.
First nonzero surface water does not constitute a qualified physical activation threshold.
Conhtop is not promoted to the continuation receiver.
Layer1 aqueous or sorbed NH4 is not selected as receiver.
Historical revision-53 rewetting behaviour remains UNKNOWN_WITHOUT_B2.
No B3 admission or production implementation is authorized.
